name: own-the-why
description: Work fast with AI without disconnecting from the concepts: your hypothesis and your reason come before the AI's.

interface.shortDescription: Keep thinking while working fast with AI
interface.longDescription: In new concepts, bug root causes and design decisions, Codex asks for your hypothesis or your reason in one line before giving its own, and explains concepts in prose that has to be read. Everything else stays fast.
defaultPrompt: Ask for my reasoning before giving yours.
